name: The page is reloaded while the renewal is in flight: the refresh token the request has spent is not sent a second time
description: Both guards of the renewal live in the page: the shared promise of the tab and the Web Lock, which the browser releases when the page unloads. The renewed token reaches the storage only when the request is over, so a reload in between leaves the spent refresh token there. With "Revoke Refresh Token" in the realm sending it again revokes the session, and the user is signed out after pressing F5 at an unlucky moment. The race is narrow: the reload happens as soon as the request is seen in the network log, and it is the real one, without any hook of the tests.
